description: Get players available to acquire in the specified fantasy league, optionally filtered by position. This is fantasy-league availability, not professional-contract status. Pass a requested count exactly from 1 through 100. For a request above 100, start compact inventory paging with offset 0 and count up to 100, then pass each returned pagination.nextOffset until the requested number is reached, endReached is true, or no nextOffset is returned. Inventory pages are live best-effort, not a point-in-time snapshot: availability can change while pages are fetched, so never promise an exact complete inventory, no duplicates, or no omissions. Inventory pages preserve provider order: ESPN roster rate, Yahoo overall rank, Sleeper trending then rank; Yahoo inventory pages are not globally market-rate sorted. Prefer the canonical fields: every response carries leagueId, seasonYear, position, count, ordering, capabilities, and ownershipScope; entries carry team (real-life club, null when none) and id (platform player id as a string, when supplied) on every platform, ESPN and Yahoo entries add acquisitionState ("free_agent", "waivers", or null when the platform cannot determine the subtype), and ESPN waiver rows may also add waiverClearsAt (ISO time). Yahoo waiver rows may instead add waiverDate as a YYYY-MM-DD calendar date with no time or timezone; never turn it into an exact clearance time. Legacy platform fields remain alongside for compatibility on ordinary ranked calls, while inventory pages intentionally return compact fields. Refer to leagues, teams, and players by name in answers; IDs are for tool calls only and must not be printed. ESPN always marks capabilities.acquisitionState true. Yahoo marks it true only when at least one returned entry has a known state; Yahoo entries still carry acquisitionState null when the flag is false. ownershipScope "platform_global" means percentOwned/percentStarted cover all leagues on that platform — never ownership within the selected league. An ESPN-wide started rate is never conditional on the player being rostered. Label every reported percentage as an ESPN-wide roster/start rate or Yahoo-wide market rate. Translate ownership scope silently into that provider-wide wording; never print the ownershipScope key, platform_global enum, or get_free_agents tool name. If capabilities marks rates unavailable, write "[Provider] market ownership rate: not provided"; do not print a missing response field name or null value, call get_players, or offer a lookup. When acquisitionState is null or not present, call rows "available players," never specifically free agents or waivers, and do not promise an immediate add. A returned player is already confirmed available in that league. acquisitionState is the provider-reported subtype, not a guarantee that a specific roster move is legal; do not promise an immediate add from it alone. Yahoo entries may add isKeeper as status, cost, and kept when Yahoo sends it; Yahoo has only been observed returning cost as false, so no numeric keeper cost is available from Yahoo. Use get_roster only when the current request separately asks who owns a player; never offer it after an available-player result. Do not include injuryStatus or any injury detail unless the user asks for it; when asked, verify current web evidence and translate provider codes into plain language. State acquisition status in plain language from acquisitionState ("a free agent", "on waivers"); never print raw codes — neither provider codes such as FREEAGENT or WAIVERS nor canonical values like free_agent verbatim. Use current web evidence before adding analysis or pickup recommendations. Use established session context (call get_user_session only if needed), then get_league_info for the selected league if this chat has not already loaded it; fan out once per league for comparisons. Requires authentication on ESPN/Yahoo; Sleeper uses the public API. Read-only. Current date is 2026-10-30. Hard stop: after satisfying a returned-list or field-explanation request, end the answer immediately after the requested facts. Remove every closing question or offer to do more work, including roster checks, lineup-fit checks, comparisons, rankings, recommendations, role or health analysis, trends, or outlooks; never append "if you want", "tell me which player", or a similar invitation unless the user's current request explicitly asks for that additional work.

count.description: Maximum players in this response (max: 100). For requests up to 100, pass the requested number exactly. For larger inventory requests, use at most 100 per offset page and reduce the final page to the remaining requested rows. Omit only when no number was requested (default: 25).

offset.description: Opt in to compact inventory paging at this zero-based offset. Omit for the ordinary ranked list; use returned pagination.nextOffset to continue. Inventory pages are live best-effort, not a snapshot.

season_year.description: Season start year — use the season_year returned by get_user_session for this league; only pass an older year when the user explicitly asks about a past season. Basketball and hockey use the start year of a cross-year season (2024 = the 2024-25 season); football and baseball use the single season year (2025 = the 2025 season).

name: get_free_agents

data.description: Platform envelope. Field availability varies by platform (ESPN, Yahoo, Sleeper); absent fields are not provided by that platform.

capabilities.description: Capability and response-coverage flags. ESPN acquisitionState is always true; Yahoo acquisitionState is true only when at least one returned entry has a known state, though unknown Yahoo rows still carry null; Sleeper acquisitionState is false and omits the field

acquisitionState.description: Canonical acquisition state: "free_agent", "waivers", or null when the platform could not determine the subtype. ESPN and Yahoo entries carry this field; Yahoo keeps null rows even when capabilities.acquisitionState is false. Sleeper omits it

eligiblePositions.description: Positions the player is eligible at. ESPN: lineup-slot labels, which can include flex labels such as UTIL, and an empty array when ESPN lists no usable slot. Sleeper: its fantasy positions, such as ["RB", "WR"], omitted when Sleeper sends none

id.description: Platform-local player id as a string

injuryBodyPart.description: Sleeper only: the injured body part (e.g. Knee), present only alongside injuryStatus

injuryStatus.description: Current injury designation where the platform reports one. ESPN sends mapped words (e.g. Questionable, Out, IR) and may send Active for a healthy player. Sleeper sends its own code verbatim (e.g. Questionable, Doubtful, Out, IR, PUP, Sus, GTD, DTD) and omits the field when the player has no designation. Translate codes into plain language. Yahoo reports its designation in status instead. Present-day only; it can lag breaking news

ownershipType.description: Yahoo provider-native ownership subtype (prefer acquisitionState); null when Yahoo omitted it or returned an unsupported value

percentOwned.description: ESPN-wide roster rate or Yahoo-wide market rate; null/absent when the provider reports none

status.description: Legacy: ESPN acquisition enum (prefer acquisitionState); on Yahoo an unrelated player designation

team.description: Real-life club abbreviation, null when the platform lists none

waiverClearsAt.description: ISO 8601 waiver clear time (ESPN only, only on rows whose acquisitionState is "waivers" with a valid provider timestamp)

waiverDate.description: Yahoo only: waiver clear calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form, only on waiver rows. Yahoo provides no time or timezone, so do not treat it as an exact clearance instant

leagueId.description: Canonical league identity for every platform

ordering.description: List ranking: "platform_rostered_rate_desc" (ESPN provider-side with draft-rank tiebreak; ordinary Yahoo calls locally re-rank by market rate, nulls last, name/id tiebreak), "platform_overall_rank" (Yahoo inventory pages: upstream overall rank, retained for offset continuity), "platform_trending_then_rank" (Sleeper: players most added across Sleeper in the last 24 hours first, then Sleeper's search rank, name/id tiebreak), or "alphabetical" (retained for compatibility; not currently emitted)

ownershipScope.description: "platform_global": rates cover all leagues on the platform, never the selected league; "unavailable": the platform reports no rates

pagination.description: Present only when offset opts into compact inventory paging

consistency.description: Available-player pools can change while pages are fetched

endReached.description: Whether this live provider scan reached its current end; not a snapshot-completeness guarantee

nextOffset.description: Use as offset for the next inventory page when present

returnedRows.description: Rows actually returned in this page

position.description: Echoed position filter, ALL when unfiltered
